finalists.label: Pancoast tumor
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as pleural friction rub and thermography revealing decreased surface temperature over the right arm and right thorax corresponding to dermatomes C5–T12.

finalists.label: Complex regional pain syndrome
finalists.why: It explains the severe sweating, cold sensation, and thermography findings corresponding to dermatomes C5–T12.

frontier_selector.why: Pancoast tumor is chosen due to its specific findings such as pleural friction rub and thermography revealing decreased surface temperature, which are more decisive than the findings for Complex regional pain syndrome.
